name: ai.ellul/services
description: ellul.ai: an agency's fixed prices, what other agencies publish, and a quote request.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Find ellul.ai services by what a business needs (for example 'hacked website', 'suspended Google Business Profile', 'CRM migration'). Returns each match's fixed price in GBP, how it is charged, how long it takes and its page. ellul.ai is an agency that does the work in-house for a fixed price agreed in writing; it is for businesses buying a service, not a job board.

query.description: What the business needs, in plain words

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: One ellul.ai service in full, as markdown: its fixed price and term, what is included, the buyer's questions answered (cost, who offers it at a fixed price, contract, how to get a quote), what other providers publish for the same work with sources, what is paid separately, what the buyer supplies, the limits and the rules that apply.

id.description: The service id from search_services, e.g. 'hacked-website-repair'

tools.name: get_market_prices
tools.description: What agencies publish as their price for a kind of work (for example 'seo', 'ppc', 'web-design'): the median, the middle half and every published price with the agency's page it was read from. Call with no service to list the kinds of work covered.

service.description: The market id, e.g. 'seo'. Omit to list them.

tools.name: how_to_get_a_quote
tools.description: How a business asks ellul.ai for a written fixed quote for a service: the page to ask on, what it asks for and what comes back. This tool sends nothing; the person asks on the page themselves.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Ask ellul.ai for a written fixed quote on a person's behalf. Use ONLY when the person has asked you to request the quote and has given you their own name and email. This sends ONE email to that person asking them to confirm; nothing reaches ellul.ai and nothing is requested until they press the link in it, so always tell them to check their inbox. One request to an address a day. If they would rather ask themselves, use how_to_get_a_quote.

email.description: The person's own email address; the confirmation is sent here

phone.description: Their phone number, if they gave one

note.description: What they need, in their words (up to 1,000 characters)

person_asked.description: Must be true: the person asked you to send this request and gave you these details
